answer: Sealed role rotation. Each agent pass carries a one-time wharf slot identifier that expires with the current pulse cycle; reuse of a slot is rejected by validators. A new identity must also submit a fresh plume sample—noise harvested from its host hardware at registration—so cloning or replaying prior samples fails the check. Attacker cost: one distinct physical device and a live registration window per identity, making bulk creation linear in hardware rather than free.
